links.outcome: Readability (FKGL) of chatbot answers to patient questions about hypersensitivity pneumonitis
links.effect: FKGL ranged 20.17 to 29.07 (mean about 24-25, college/postgraduate level); no chatbot met the patient-appropriate FKGL of 8 or below. WRR fell from 67.85 (Q1) to 51.227 (Q4).
links.quote: No chatbot produced content within the recommended patient-appropriate range (FKGL ≤ 8).

screen.reason: The study evaluates the quality, readability, and reliability of various commercial LLM chatbots answering patient-oriented questions about hypersensitivity pneumonitis, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or intervention.
